newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ yr 5 electricity contract clears at 4.59 c/kWh.
newsitem.headline: NZ yr 5 electricity contract clears at 4.59 c/kWh.

text.p: State-owned power generator Electricity Corporation of New Zealand Ltd (ECNZ) said on Monday that year-five electricity price contracts cleared at 4.59 cents per kilowatt hour at its fourth tender round, four cents above the reserve price of 4.55.
The fourth tender closed on August 27. It was the first time that year-five contracts were on offer.
ECNZ general marketing manager Peter Larsen said good demand by tender participants again pushed contract clearing prices above reserve.
"Similar to the previous tenders the demand for electricity price guarantee contracts exceeded the amount on offer in some time zones," he said in a statement.

In the fourth tender, the volume of contracts offered was:
1,908 GWh (gigawatt hours) of year-two contracts; 1,091 GWh of year-three, 1,140 GWh of year-four, and 1,367 GWh of year-five.
Of these volumes, 89 percent of year-two, 98 percent of year-three, 94 percent of year-four, and 96 percent of year-five contracts were allocated, Larsen said.
The fifth and final tender round, which offers contracts for years two, three and four, closes on September 17.
